introduction.content: Blockchain Baccarat - a card game with Fairness Guarantees, the new breakthrough with blockchain technology. The game uses 8 decks of cards (416 cards excluding the joker). There are 7 betting options and Punters can bet on one or more betting options shown on the game table.

details.line1: By default, 6 cards will be drawn at the beginning of each round. Player and Banker, each hand will start with 2 cards face down.
details.line2: The third card will be dealt according to the total points of the first 2 cards on each hand.
details.line3: If the round ends with a total of less than 6 cards dealt, the remaining cards will be used for the next round.
details.line4: The game determines the win or loss by comparing the total points of all cards on each hand and the winning hand is the one closest to a total of 9 points.
details.line5: All bets must be placed before the betting time expires. Note, placed bets cannot be canceled.
details.line6: The maximum total stake per round is {{maxBetMain}}

content.Player: The Player hand will win if the total points of Player are higher than Banker.
content.Banker: The Banker hand will win if the total points of Banker are higher than Player.
content.Tie: The Punter wins if two hands (Player and Banker) have finished with equal totals.
content.Player pair: The Punter wins if the first two cards of the Player are a pair, irrespective of suit.
content.Banker pair: The Punter wins if the first two cards of the Banker are a pair, irrespective of suit.
content.Big: The Punter wins if the total numbers of cards that have been dealt in one round are 5 or 6.
content.Small: The Punter wins if the total numbers of cards that have been dealt in one round are 4.

cutCard.description: Cut Card: a special card is used to indicate where the shoe will end and all cards will be reshuffled. Cut Card will  be inserted in the middle of the card pack (416 cards) at the beginning of the new shoe.

burnCard.description: After the Cut Card has been inserted, there is a burn card process. The number of card that will be burned (discard without using), is dependent on the value of the first card taken out of the new Shoe.
burnCard.noted: Note: The first card on top of the card pack (416 cards) is also discarded.

descriptions.line1: If the first card is 5 => 6 cards will be removed (5 burned cards + the first card)
descriptions.line2: If the first card is K => 11 cards will be removed (10 burned cards + K card)

details.line1: The cards (2 to 9) are counted at face value.
details.line2: 10 or face cards (Jack, Queen, King) have a value of 0, and Aces have a value of 1

descriptions.paragraph2: When the total points exceed nine, the first digit of the total is dropped, and the second digit is the value of the hand.

descriptions: A third card will be dealt according to the strict rules of the game.
If the total points of the first two cards of either hand are 8 or 9, this is called a “Natural” and no more cards are dealt, both the player and banker stand.
